highlights: patch22r（全项目深度 review 根修）SSE 断连死锁根治（账号租约/并发槽位泄漏）、extract 取消接线、store 双文件写序+fsync、幂等索引抽取双域统一（图片域补齐落盘）。
patch22r 可靠性：engine.start() CDP 探活自愈、页面死检测快速换号、TetherPool 重绑去重（约束不再丢失）、备份/回源退避分离、回源超时按体积伸缩。
patch22r 安全：key 日志脱敏+rotate 持久化进 data 卷、/v1/videos 轮询字段白名单（prompt 不再全量回显）、媒体回源负缓存防未鉴权放大、扩展 popup XSS 根治（host_permissions 收窄+动态申请）。

继续保留二开 7-22q 全部补丁：TetherPool 出口托管、per-account 指纹隔离、幂等/并发/重绑/attempt 审计、归档索引与任务保留加固等。
highlights_en: patch22r (full-project deep review root fixes): SSE disconnect deadlock eliminated (lease/slot leak), extract cancel wiring, store two-file write order + fsync, idempotency index unified for video+image (image domain now persisted).

patch22r reliability: engine.start() CDP liveness self-heal, page-lost fast-fail with account rotation, TetherPool double-acquire removed (constraints preserved), backup/delivery backoff split, size-based fetch timeout.

patch22r security: key log masking + rotate persistence inside data volume, /v1/videos polling whitelist (no prompt echo), media negative cache vs unauth amplification, extension popup XSS root fix (narrowed host_permissions + dynamic request).

patch22r gating: pinned requirements + dev extras, real TestClient smoke regression (startup-cycle incidents now caught pre-deploy), compose/Dockerfile drift guards (TASKS_MAX 2000, HEALTHCHECK, MANAGED_DEPLOYMENT, mem_limit 2500m).

Extension 1.0.4: popup log switched to textContent (injection-immune), service-origin permission now requested dynamically (optional_host_permissions). Upgrade is manual: reload the extension at chrome://extensions (once for every browser profile); the notice appears automatically vs 1.0.3.
All local patches 7-22q remain: TetherPool egress management, per-account fingerprint isolation, idempotency, concurrency, rebind, attempt audit, archive index and task retention hardening.
